story_position: Chapter 3 — Beat 14 — Cresthaven / Ancient Tower Base / First Command Warden
hard_outcomes: Normal abandoned Cresthaven is explored first.
The fort is confirmed to sit over/within a much larger Ancient tower foundation.
Mirena and Maevra remain aboveground as noncombat story/support characters.
The permanent four complete a short Ancient dungeon: Tower Foundation, Command Interior, Warden Chamber.
The First Command Warden assesses the entire four-person party, finds the result unacceptable/insufficient, and attacks.
After defeat the Warden says PREVIOUS ERROR then LAST SENTINEL CONFIRMED, with LAST SENTINEL CONFIRMED as its final message.
The Warden becomes fully inert before Cyanis's Card changes.
Only afterward the Card stabilizes deep Ruby.
No new map or Ivorybridge clue appears.
